verdict.rationale: Polar documents registrable webhook endpoints that deliver events asynchronously instead of polling. Endpoint CRUD is available via a Webhook Events API, and webhooks follow the Standard Webhooks spec with SDK signature validation and typed payloads. The docs also cover delivery monitoring and local testing via `polar listen`. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of webhook delivery, and an explicit event-type catalog and retry policy in the evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Get notifications asynchronously when events occur instead of having to poll for updates
a Webhook Events API covers endpoint CRUD in the versioned API reference
